rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely: module ID, cookieFilterAction reuse, Validate, Caddyfile block shape, interface guards; reuses hash().
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through via Response.Cookies(); suffix kept verbatim; quotes preserved; exact name match; delete drops entry. Drops whitespace around the value inside name=value on rewrite.
rationale.scope: Only the new filter plus registration and guards; no unrelated edits or dead code.
rationale.readability: Filter body is one long function mixing lookup, parsing and rewriting; a small helper would clarify. Names are fine; comments adequate.
rationale.robustness: No panic paths: bounds checked before slicing, non-array input returned unchanged, empty cookie list handled; builds a Response per value which is cheap enough.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile and Validate are copy-pasted from CookieFilter rather than shared; inline parsing logic would be hard to reuse or test in isolation.
